title: 第737章 十六人冲阵第736章 蛊师威粉墨登场
slug: 玄幻真龙为骨我刀问天下
content_zh:
约莫一盏茶的功夫过后，妖族大军死了数万余，尸横遍野，大地都染成了血红色。
半空中猴子和大傻相继落回云深城头。
两人四境的修为根本不足以支撑这么长时间的消耗，再不歇一歇，怕是要力竭而亡。
“两位大蛊师也知道累？”看着瘫坐在城头的两人，陆去疾笑着打趣道。
猴子取下覆在脸上的牛头傩面，露出了煞白的脸，一脸虚弱道：“陆哥，我是真遭不住了。”
大傻喘着粗气道：“我、我也遭不住了，那独角仙都快把俺吸干了。”
陆去疾不知道从哪里掏出了一个鸡腿，递到大傻身前，故意重复了大傻的话：
“慢慢吃，下面我来接管战场。”
大傻那张傻得可爱的圆脸红得像苹果，有些不好意思道：“陆哥，你可别打趣俺了，俺刚才是想露露脸。”
陆去疾的手在大傻肩膀上轻轻拍了下，说了声：“没给苗疆丢脸。”
大傻没再说话，只是笑嘻嘻的接过鸡腿大口啃了起来，眼角却不自觉红了。
没给苗疆丢脸，这个六个字是对他最大的肯定。
陆去疾没再说话，一步踏空百丈有余，眉心先是浮现出一抹金光，旋即光芒大甚包裹了他的全身。
俯瞰着下方剩余的十几万妖族大军，他自言自语道：“要不？我也来一次粉墨登场？”
紧接着，整个战场的妖卒都听到了一道震耳欲聋的声音——“本座江南总司司主陆去疾，今日镇杀万妖谷！！！”
轰——！
陆去疾的身影如一道白虹坠入妖族大军中央，落地的刹那，仿佛天外陨星撞入凡尘！
“轰——”的
方圆数百丈的地面瞬间崩裂，泥土如浪翻涌，无数道裂缝如蛛网般向四周疯狂蔓延。
随后，成千上万的妖卒被巨大冲击力弹起，像是秋风卷落叶，毫无抵抗之力地抛向半空。

离得近的数百位妖卒浑身骨骼在气浪中寸寸碎裂，血雾弥漫开来，将天际都染了一层薄薄的红晕。
陆去疾的身形没有丝毫停滞，脚尖轻点碎裂的地面，整个人化作一道闪电从半空中那些妖卒中间穿过！
一瞬，仅仅一瞬！
陆去疾所过之处，妖卒如雨落大地，噼里啪啦砸在泥泞里，再无生息！
有妖卒至死都瞪大了眼，它们低头看着自己破了洞的胸口，一脸茫然。
“什么时候……”
“他的速度怎么这么快……”
不等它们想明白，身形便不受控制的坠向地面，再也站不起身来。
陆去疾缓缓落地，面如平湖，好似做了一件微不足道的小事。
他看向剩余的妖卒，轻声道：“紫云。”
话音刚落，一柄紫色重刀便凭空出现在他手中。
与此同时，妖族大军终于反应过来，嘶吼着从两翼合围，黑压压的妖潮再度涌来，似要吞陆去疾。
城头之上，二戒一直在数念珠。
佛珠转了一圈，他睁开眼，那双素来懒散的眸子里，罕见地起了杀意。
content_en:
After about a cup of tea, more than tens of thousands of the demon army were dead. Corpses were scattered all over the field, and the earth was dyed blood red.
In mid-air, Monkey and Dasha fell back to the top of Yunshen City one after another.
The cultivation of the two people in the four realms is simply not enough to sustain such a long period of consumption. If they don't take a break, they may die from exhaustion.
"Do the two great Gu masters know how tired they are?" Lu Quji joked with a smile, looking at the two people sitting paralyzed at the top of the city.
The monkey took off the bull-headed Nuo noodles covering his face, revealing his pale face, and said with a weak look: "Brother Lu, I really can't bear it anymore."
Dasha gasped and said: "I, I can't stand it anymore, that one-horned fairy is almost sucking me dry."
Lu Quji took out a chicken leg from somewhere, handed it to Dasha, and deliberately repeated Dasha's words:
"Eat slowly, I will take over the battlefield next."
Dasha's silly and adorable round face was as red as an apple, and he said a little embarrassedly: "Brother Lu, please stop teasing me, I just wanted to show off my face."
Lu Quji gently patted Dasha's shoulder with his hand and said, "I didn't embarrass Miao Jiang."
Dasha didn't say anything anymore, he just took the chicken leg and gnawed it with a smile, but the corners of his eyes turned red unconsciously.
Miao Jiang was not embarrassed. These six words were the greatest affirmation for him.
Lu Quji didn't say anything anymore. He took one step more than a hundred feet into the air. A golden light first appeared between his eyebrows, and then the light enveloped his whole body.
Looking down at the remaining hundreds of thousands of demon clan troops below, he said to himself: "How about? I also make a grand appearance?"
Immediately afterwards, all the demon soldiers on the battlefield heard a deafening voice - "I, the Chief of the Jiangnan General Department, Lu Quji, are going to kill the Ten Thousand Demons Valley today!!!"
Boom——!
Lu Quji's figure fell into the center of the monster army like a white rainbow. The moment he landed, it was like a meteor from the sky crashing into the mortal world!
"Boom——"
The ground with a radius of hundreds of feet instantly cracked, the soil surged like waves, and countless cracks spread crazily around like spider webs.
Then, thousands of demon soldiers were bounced up by the huge impact, like fallen leaves blown by the autumn wind, thrown into the air without any resistance.
The bones of the hundreds of demon soldiers who were nearby were shattered inch by inch in the air waves, and the blood mist spread, dyeing the sky with a thin layer of red.
Lu Quji's figure did not stop at all. He tapped the broken ground with his toes, and his whole body turned into a bolt of lightning and passed through the demon soldiers in mid-air!
A moment, just a moment!
Wherever Lu Quji passed, demon soldiers fell to the ground like rain, clattering into the mud, never to survive again!
Some of the demon soldiers stared with their eyes wide open until they died. They looked down at their holes in their chests, with blank expressions on their faces.
"When..."
"Why is he so fast..."
Before they could figure it out, their bodies fell to the ground uncontrollably and could no longer stand up.
Lu Quji landed slowly, his face as flat as a lake, as if he had done a trivial thing.
He looked at the remaining demon soldiers and whispered: "Ziyun."
As soon as he finished speaking, a heavy purple knife appeared out of thin air in his hand.
At the same time, the demon army finally reacted, roaring and encircling from both sides, and the black demon tide surged in again, seeming to swallow up the land.
On top of the city, Erjie has been counting beads.
The beads spun in a circle and he opened his eyes. There was a rare murderous intent in his usually lazy eyes.
